name: KFC Shinjuku West Exit
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 新宿西口店
description: A busy KFC by the west exit of Shinjuku Station where the second-floor counter has free KFC Wi-Fi and a power outlet plus USB port at all 22 seats, making it a handy spot for laptop work.

name: KFC Ikebukuro West Exit
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 池袋西口店
description: A multi-floor KFC near the west exit of Ikebukuro Station with free KFC Wi-Fi and about ten third-floor counter seats that each have a power outlet and USB ports.

name: KFC Takadanobaba
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 高田馬場店
description: A KFC close to Takadanobaba Station with free KFC Wi-Fi and around fifteen counter seats that each have a power outlet, good for a quiet work stop.

name: KFC Ebisu Station-mae
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 恵比寿駅前店
description: A KFC right in front of Ebisu Station with free d Wi-Fi and power outlets along the second-floor counter seats, useful for laptop work.

name: KFC Shibuya Dogenzaka
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 渋谷道玄坂店
description: A KFC on the Dogenzaka slope near Shibuya Station with free d Wi-Fi and power outlets at the second-floor seats, including the non-smoking area.

name: KFC Akihabara
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 秋葉原店
description: A KFC near Akihabara Station with free d Wi-Fi and customer power outlets on the upper floors, though some outlets have at times been switched off, so it is worth checking on arrival.

name: KFC Shimbashi
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 新橋店
description: A KFC near Shimbashi Station with power outlets (two sockets per seat) across several floors; the store's own free Wi-Fi is not confirmed, so plan to use your own connection.

name: KFC Gotanda
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 五反田店
address: 5-27-6 Higashi-Gotanda, Dai-ichi Gotanda Building, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A KFC close to Gotanda Station with about twelve counter seats that each have a power outlet, but no confirmed store Wi-Fi, so bring your own connection.

name: KFC Nihonbashi Ningyocho
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 日本橋人形町店
description: A KFC near Ningyocho Station with power outlets at counter seats on both floors (about fifteen seats), though free store Wi-Fi is not confirmed.

name: KFC Denenchofu
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 田園調布店
description: A KFC near Den-en-chofu Station with free d Wi-Fi and customer power outlets, handy for a short laptop session, though the exact number of outlets is unclear.

name: KFC Keio Sasazuka
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 京王笹塚店
address: 1-55-16 Sasazuka, Keio Crown-gai Sasazuka East, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
description: A small KFC by Sasazuka Station with about five power outlets at the counter seats, though store Wi-Fi is not confirmed.

name: KFC Asakusa
nameJa: ケンタッキーフライドチキン 浅草店
description: A KFC near Asakusa Station with free Wi-Fi but no usable power outlets, so it works better for a short visit than long laptop work.
